plugins.name: neo-dev-toolkit
plugins.description: Opinionated Claude Code toolkit: neo is a thin loop wrapper over the agent-skills SDLC (recursive goal → iterate against an exit condition → human gate), with an ingest memory primitive, GitLab/Atlassian connectors, API-doc tooling, and Go service scaffolding/migration. Requires the upstream agent-skills plugin (github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills) — it provides the using-agent-skills SDLC that neo delegates to.
